title: Correct force magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the Coulomb force magnitude as 9.0 × 10⁻³ N.

title: Correct force direction
description: Essential: The answer must state the force on q₂ is repulsive and directed away from A (e.g., along AB to the right).

title: Correct field magnitude
description: Essential: The answer must state the electric field magnitude at B as 4.5 × 10³ N/C.

title: Applies Coulomb's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the formula F = k|q₁q₂|/L² for the force calculation.

title: Applies point-charge field formula
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the formula E = k|q₁|/L² for the field calculation.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answers should include correct SI units (N and N/C).

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force direction is incorrectly stated as attractive or toward charge A.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the wrong formula (e.g., omits squaring L, uses q₂ in the field formula).
